start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj plants ko herbs, shrubs aur trees mein group karenge. Aapka din kaisa raha?

turns.line: tulsi herb hai kyunki uska stem soft hota hai
turns.reply: Bilkul, aapne soft stem ka sahi clue pakda. Ab neem ke stem ko imagine kijiye—soft hoga ya hard woody? Ruk kar reason batayiye.
Sahi, aam ka ped tree hai: uska stem hard woody hota hai aur woh usually tall hota hai. Shrub ke stem mein kya farq hoga?

record.summary:
Kabir identified tulsi as a herb because it has a soft stem.
Kabir identified the mango plant as a tree.
The lesson covered grouping plants as herbs, shrubs, and trees.
record.parentNote: Kabir practised grouping plants by their type and used the stem of tulsi to explain why it is a herb. Kabir also identified a mango plant as a tree. At home, ask Kabir to sort a few nearby plants into herbs, shrubs, and trees and give one reason for each.
